items.label: Unmatched Speed & Massive Storage (16GB RAM + 512GB)
items.value: Experience desktop-level performance with the cutting-edge Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor, flawlessly handling intensive gaming, multitasking, and demanding apps. Paired with a colossal 16GB of RAM, apps launch instantly, switch seamlessly, and stay ready in the background. This powerhouse combination ensures consistently smooth, lag-free operation, significantly faster app loading, and effortless handling of complex tasks compared to lower-memory models, making it a true performance champion.

items.label: Immersive 6.99" FHD+ Display & Premium Stylus Included
items.value: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals on the expansive 6.99-inch FHD+ display, significantly larger than standard flagship screens.Enjoy vibrant colors, deep blacks, and incredible detail whether you're streaming movies, browsing the web, or gaming. Precision meets creativity with the included premium Stylus Pen. Take effortless notes, sketch ideas, edit photos with pinpoint accuracy, or navigate your phone with enhanced control – all directly on the brilliant screen. Transform your smartphone into a powerful productivity and creative tool right out of the box.

items.label: Professional-Grade 68MP + 108MP Dual Camera System
items.value: Capture breathtaking photos and videos like a pro.The advanced dual-camera system features a primary 68MP Ultra-High Resolution sensor that captures incredible detail, even in challenging lighting, and allows for lossless zoom.The secondary 108MP sensor excels in ultra-wide shots, macro photography, or depth sensing for stunning portraits with beautiful bokeh. Expect sharp, vivid images day or night, vibrant video recording, and versatile shooting modes that put DSLR-like quality in your pocket. Capture every moment with unparalleled clarity and creativity.

items.label: All-Day & Beyond 7000mAh Mega Battery with Android 14
items.value: Power through your busiest days and well into the next without searching for an outlet.The massive 7000mAh battery is engineered for extreme endurance, easily supporting 2 full days of heavy use – streaming, gaming, navigation, and more.Run the latest apps and features securely on the brand-new Android 14 operating system, offering enhanced privacy controls, improved customization, smoother animations, and the latest Google innovations. Enjoy peace of mind with top-tier security and a modern, intuitive user interface designed for maximum efficiency and a premium user experience.

items.label: Advanced Security & Premium Design (Dual Unlock)
items.value: Unlock your phone instantly and securely with Dual Unlock technology, combining blazing-fast Face Unlock and a reliable under-display Fingerprint Sensor.Choose the method that's most convenient in any situation. All this cutting-edge technology is housed in a sleek, premium design built for durability and comfort.Experience flagship-level build quality, a stunning large-screen form factor, and the confidence that comes with owning a device equipped with the absolute latest hardware and software, designed to excel in every aspect of modern smartphone use.
